scope: Segment 149 field-level rules for Comdata fuel price updates

rules.title: Segment 149 contains data required by the Comdata authorizer for fuel price updates
Field Separators appear between fields 1-2, 2-3, and 3-4; the segment should end with a trailing Field Separator; data fields within field 4 (Price Data) are NOT separated by Field Separators
rules.note: Same pattern class as Segment 135 (per-field separators + internal-TLV exception).

rules.title: Segment Type fixed 149, Segment Length 3 digits, Terminal Identifier (var.), Price Data (var., pipe-delimited tag:value pairs e.g. 'CASS:03.00') all Device-sourced
rules.note: Worked example confirms the Price Data sub-format: |TAG:VALUE|TAG:VALUE|... (e.g. '|CASS:03.00|CRSS:3.05|').
